text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Financial Procedure) (Amendment) Order, 2008. of section 7 of Const. III.

Section 8 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection 2{d}, by deleting "s~bsection (4)" and by substituting "subsections (4) and (4A)" therefor. Made this 26th. day of Muharam, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of February, 2008 at Our lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
